items.title: CISA Warns of SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description:
CISA added a SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN vulnerability, CVE-2026-19868, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, warning that valid-credential users can bypass SAML authentication controls and potentially evade multi-factor authentication. CISA added the vulnerability on November 6, 2026, and set a November 20 remediation deadline. Its entry lists ransomware use as unknown and does not require forensic […]
 The post  CISA Warns of SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Vulnerability Exploited in Attac

ttps.tactic: Defense Evasion / Persistence / Privilege Escalation / Initial Access
ttps.justification: Technique applies because: credential. The Valid Accounts technique is relevant because this vulnerability's attack mechanism aligns with Defense Evasion / Persistence / Privilege Escalation / Initial Access phase behavior (analyst inference from advisory text).
ttps.observed_behavior: NOT OBSERVED. Hypothesis from the vulnerability description: exploiting 'CISA Warns of SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks' could enable Valid Accounts (T1078) in the Defense Evasion / Persistence / Privilege Escalation / Initial Access phase. No adversary use of this technique is reported by the source.
